mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar, status, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar, status, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, password, nickname, email, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{status})
